message:

Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]

hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: system has 2 refunds (121,122) but Alpha reported 3 (121,122,124)

reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in my system before proceeding with payouts. I will retrieve the refunds list for verification.

The refunds list from the system shows only two refunds (order_ids 121 and 122), but Alpha Co reported three refunds (including order_id 124). This discrepancy requires a hold to prevent incorrect payouts.
